title: Openwheel Racing 1.21.11
description: A Minecraft mod on 1.21.11 for openwheel racing (F1), including track building and car driving!
body:
**Openwheel Racing** is a Minecraft Forge mod for Minecraft `1.21.11` that adds an open-wheel racing progression loop: craft and assemble a prototype race car, tune its setup, build circuits, refine crude oil resources, and race laps with timing, tyre wear, and crash damage.

**From version 1.3.0+** (car remodeling update), we attribute the car modeling to `"NEW F1 CAR 2026" (2026) by Abu Saif is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)`. Upon the honored original author's work, we remeshed it to 10% the original mesh density to prevent graphics overload. Livery is added via code.
